raw_text: Anti-austerity protests have erupted in central Colombo as thousands of Sri Lankans gathered near the Presidential Secretariat demanding the government reverse IMF-mandated tax increases. Demonstrators blocked several key intersections in the Fort area. Security forces deployed tear gas and water cannons to disperse the crowds. At least 15 protesters were arrested.
clean_text: Anti-austerity protests erupt in central Colombo. Thousands block Fort area intersections. Security forces use tear gas, 15 arrested.
